Correction pass. Regenerate the mask surrogate and strictly enforce all constraints.
Target: polyp
Hard requirements:
- Exact input resolution
- Background every pixel must be #00FF00
- ROI every pixel must be #FFFFFF
- Exactly two colors in output
- No labels/text/graphics
If any requirement cannot be met, still output the best compliant two-color mask image.
Blob profile: delineate the full visible target extent with a tight but complete boundary.
Minimum ROI area fraction: 0.0
Maximum ROI area fraction: 1.0
Minimum connected components: 1
Maximum connected components: 1024
Tool mode: text + image grounding enabled. Use retrieval for reasoning only; output must remain original mask surrogate pixels.
NanoBanana image-generation mode: return one generated image only, with no markdown, JSON, or explanatory text.
